review.primitives: 60 complete pinned NIST ML-KEM-768 cases (25 keygen/25 encap/10 decap, 5 implicit-rejection ciphertexts); RFC 7748 X25519 section 6.1 and RFC 8439 AEAD section 2.8.2. Empty-AAD allocating/detached wrapper oracle from independent Python cryptography, first checked against RFC; every ciphertext/tag byte mutation fails. Existing RFC 8448 AES-128 record vector and AES-256 integration/roundtrip reviewed; detailed outer TLS remains Q11. Independent Python HKDF checks all four wire schemes.
review.static_binding: Ephemeral checked DH, static_es checked DH before KDF, both checked proof verifiers, domain separation, transcript/input change negatives. Raw/fake-TLS TCP and UDP credential send ordering reviewed; duplex raw handshake rejects forged proof before trust callback and rejects failed trust before credential bytes. JOIN/resume tokens also follow verifier/admission.
review.trust: Explicit pins admitted before credentials; Linux bounded known_hosts UTF8/size/errors/conflicts and serialized TOFU publication, owned worker cancellation tests reviewed. TOFU is first-contact trust and persistence opt-out is explicit, not equivalent to verified out-of-band pin.
review.rng_nonce: X25519 and ML-KEM getrandom/OS sources, rand 0.10.2 ChaCha12 thread RNG seeded by SysRng and reseeded every 64KiB; entropy errors panic/abort, no weak fallback. Supervisor workers exec current_exe; no continued post-fork RNG state in current paths. Packet seed-counter bijection and reconnect fresh key contract reviewed; true counter exhaustion tested for raw/TLS before wrap, clears stale buffer and never consumes more counters. REALITY seal requires fresh ephemeral per connection.
review.rotation_storage: 31 exact-artifact storage/API/CLI rotation checks with real old/new pinned clients before/after explicit worker restart, plus 25 restore/state checks. File size/type, symlinks, lock serialization, born-private0600/identity-dir0700 reviewed; read preserves existing owner/mode, trusted custom config paths enforced. Atomic writer private create_new temp, write/fsync/rename/parent-sync reviewed with existing failures/units.
review.memory: Enabled ml-kem zeroize feature and transitive module-lattice/hybrid-array support. Compile-time DecapKey ZeroizeOnDrop regression, X25519 Drop, SharedSecret Drop, Zeroizing loader/KDF/session buffers and credential config clones reviewed. ML-KEM helper temporary SharedKey now Zeroizing; public returned Vec/array copies are caller-owned. No total-erasure guarantee for transient copies/FFI/registers/swap/crash dumps; previously accepted AES expanded schedule limitation retained.
review.dead_code_and_claims: Removed production-unused throwaway ML-KEM key-share helper, retained real keypair/share tests; renamed false counter-wrap test to sequential regression and added boundary exhaustion. Corrected mandatory PQ scope in crypto docs and paired README/THREAT-MODEL/AUDIT/ROADMAP/COMPARISON: legacy camouflage mandatory inner PQ, current REALITY TLS classic identity-bound inner with conditional outer PQ.

desktop_integrity_limitation.description: Historical default/explicit legacy IPv4 dump variability on .10 remains unattributed; current fields and native service/binary records retained. No general .10 host preservation claim or firewall restoration/deletion.

accepted_limits: No independent external cryptographic audit, formal proof or side-channel certification; KATs establish tested compatibility, not a security proof.

Current REALITY TLS inner KEX is classic identity-bound X25519; outer PQ is conditional. AES expanded schedule zeroization remains the prior accepted memory-hygiene limitation; caller-owned transient copies are not fully erased.

Regular operator links supported and read preserves owner/mode. Bounded bytes/FIFO refusal is not a hard deadline on regular filesystem IO. Atomic/sidecar locks coordinate current writers; uncoordinated root writes/old binaries/power loss not certified.
Session key failure retains per-process fallback with warning; CLI reversible encryption remains best-effort. TOFU first contact is not an independently verified pin.
Physical platform exclusions/advisory rows unchanged. No new performance benchmark, deployment, working-service replacement or push.
